rules: All code and generated artifacts remain under research/combined_prediction_v2. Production files and the V1 policy stay unchanged.
July through September are exploratory and already inspected. They cannot be called a new blind holdout.
Freeze and hash the candidate catalogue and policies before fetching or evaluating October outcomes. Do not tune on October results.
Report every market, model family, evaluated regime, selection attempt and negative result. Market-specific routes must use prior observations only.
Online updates happen after the entire market-date, so an Open forecast cannot learn from that day's target Close.

Close-known may use its own declared Open. Other same-date inputs require source scheduled time plus ten minutes to precede target scheduled time. Actual historical posting timestamps are unavailable.
Same-size exact unique panel lists, SP/DP conditional and unconditional rates, date-clustered uncertainty, paired counts and multiple-comparison adjustment are required.
The chart source may have revised historical rows. Verify market identity and retain the existing frozen history when appending October; report all overlap differences.
Current base-model selection already used some historical outcomes. October is a new extension for this policy selection, not an immutable pre-event prediction registry.
An availability-only Kalyan probe preceded this protocol and emitted latest-date/count metadata, not panel outcomes. No October outcomes enter any policy-selection script.
